nonBlockingObservations.detail: The mobile Tasks loading PNG remains exactly byte-identical to the previously reviewed 664px-wide full-page capture for a nominal 390px viewport. Retain as inherited fixture/layout observation, not a zero-overflow claim.

visibleChanges: Global top search and bell removed across reviewed full-shell pages; new-task/account/tools controls retain space.
Tasks initial board behind the drawer shows project progress and column grip affordances; task drawer content remains legible.
Analytics discovery centering/card hierarchy remains intact in the combined prefix.
limitations: Only supplied screenshot states and pixel area were reviewed; below-viewport content, pointer/keyboard behavior, motion, accessibility semantics and real touch cannot be proven by still images.
Full-shell demo pages are dark; isolated materiality loading/error fixtures are light. This is not paired full-app light/dark acceptance for every target.
Files captures use the older demo/review implementation; do not substitute for member Sources+shelf production verification.
Welcome is unavailable-project fallback, not successful onboarding. Drive-upload shows attachment affordance, not upload/provider completion. Chat is preview, not send/persistence/voice verification.
The current Analytics screenshots show unasked discovery only; this review does not visually certify opened detail cards or the retained counting-method section after a question.

Tasks local Board/List/Calendar switching, keyboard/drag column reordering and persistence, collapsed-column interaction, invite-popover behavior and all-done completion/confetti/archive prompt are not exercised in these 18 materiality stills. Owning behavior tests and separate rendered interaction evidence remain required.
The light Tasks board material and final-state completion controls are not shown by these dark initial full-shell captures; isolated light skeletons do not substitute for a light rendered board.
Global settings floating-card behavior, Home Inbox tab and toast placement/timing are not shown in their activated state by these initial materiality screenshots.
No authentication/account-settings patch was visually reviewed or accepted here; reviewer authored K1 and explicitly excludes self-review of it.
No production deployment, user Chrome interaction, source edit, data mutation or original output-artifact change occurred. Review receipt only; release owner retains qualification authority.
